notes.title: Pre-alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Pleased to announce the first EARTH:3000 pre-alpha playtest!

Be warned, there is barely any playable content yet, this is an extremely basic networking test using an Unreal Engine game template with some assets thrown together to make sure the server and deployment pipeline are working. It doesn't reflect what the finished game will look or play like. There is no sound, it isn't optimized at all, the test server may crash and go down frequently, and there may be long gaps between updates.

That said, I figured some people might want to see the game from the very beginning, and live testing will help identify issues early on in development. I would love to hear feedback and suggestions from everyone, and please let me know what kind of bugs or problems you run into, on the Steam forums or Discord (link at bottom of announcement).

Thanks for your interest in E3K! :)
